description:
Configure rules which services certain [failure detection parameters](/ui/settings/builtin:failure-detection.environment.parameters) should apply to. For more information please refer to [Failure detection settings](https://dt-url.net/7v034gp).

These settings are not applied to [Unified services](https://dt-url.net/gy03cmt).

To programmatically manage these settings, see [API Reference](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/shortlink/service-failure-detection#settings-api).

attributes.description: The service or process group attribute to check in a rule condition.

items.description: Matches the name of the process group that hosts the service.
Matches process group tags. Use predicate type `TAG_EQUALS` for exact tag match or `TAG_KEY_EQUALS` for key-only match.
Matches the management zones assigned to the service. Use predicate type `MANAGEMENT_ZONES_CONTAINS_ALL`.
Matches the service type (e.g., WebRequest, Database, Messaging). Use predicate type `SERVICE_TYPE_EQUALS`.
Matches service tags. Use predicate type `TAG_EQUALS` for exact tag match or `TAG_KEY_EQUALS` for key-only match.

predicate.description: A predicate that tests a condition attribute value. The available fields depend on the predicate type: string predicates use `textValues` and `caseSensitive`, service type predicates use `serviceType`, management zone predicates use `managementZones`, and tag predicates use `tags` or `tagKeys`.

textValues.description: A list of text values to match against. The rule matches if the attribute value matches any of these values according to the predicate type.

caseSensitive.description: If `true`, the string comparison is case-sensitive. Default: `false`.

serviceType.description: A set of service types to match against. The rule matches if the service type is contained in this set. Only applicable for predicate type `SERVICE_TYPE_EQUALS`.

tags.description: A set of tags to match exactly. The rule matches if the entity has all specified tags (both key and value must match). Only applicable for predicate type `TAG_EQUALS`.

tagKeys.description: A set of tag keys to match. The rule matches if the entity has tags with all specified keys, regardless of tag value. Only applicable for predicate type `TAG_KEY_EQUALS`.

condition.summaryPattern: **{attribute}** _{predicate.predicateType|toLowerCase}_ {attribute|enumValue, select, SERVICE_TYPE {{predicate.serviceType}} SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_ZONE {{predicate.managementZones|mgmtZoneDisplayName|join:', '}} PG_TAG {{predicate.tags} {predicate.tagKeys}} SERVICE_TAG {{predicate.tags} {predicate.tagKeys}} other {{predicate.textValues}}}
condition.description: A condition that checks a service or process group attribute using a predicate. All conditions of a rule must be fulfilled for the rule to match.

predicate.displayName: Condition to check the attribute against
predicate.description:
The predicate that tests the value of the attribute.

The actual set of fields depends on the type of the predicate. Find the list of actual objects in the description of the type field or see [Failure detection API - JSON models](https://dt-url.net/9sg3swf).

name.description: The display name of this failure detection rule.

description.description: A short description of this failure detection rule.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is enabled. Disabled rules are not evaluated.

parameterId.description: The ID of the failure detection parameter set to apply when this rule matches. The parameter set must already exist.

conditions.description: A list of conditions for this rule. All conditions must be fulfilled for the rule to match a service.
